title: All-Hands April 2026 - Talking Points & Q&A (draft)
content:
DRAFT - notes and talking points for All-Hands Apr 2026
Owner: Zoe Park (People Ops) - last edits 2026-03-03
Collaborators: Priya K., Asha P., Lucas W.
Status: in_review - please leave comments inline or ping me in #people-ops

Objective: short, clear company update that 1) celebrates wins, 2) acknowledges areas we need to improve, 3) outlines near-term roadmap (hosting, Dedicated, Private), and 4) leaves time for live Q&A.

Agenda (15-20m exec update + 20m Q&A)
- Welcome + quick housekeeping (Zoe) - 1m
- State of the company (CEO) - 6m
  - Metrics: MRR growth, net retention, top-line usage trends (hosted API tokens up 28% QoQ).
  - Customer highlights: two new Dedicated contracts closed (enterprise finance, health partner).
  - Hiring snapshot: slow hiring in infra while we prioritize SRE and platform engineers.
- Product highlight + demo (Head of Product / Eng Lead) - 6-8m
  - Redwood Optimize: pilot with caching/batching saved a pilot customer 35% token cost - short demo or screenshot
  - Private deployment onboarding improvements (new KMS integration) - rollout timeline: GA in June
  - Roadmap shoutouts: streaming stability, function/tool calling polish, quantization profiles roadmap
- Ops & reliability update (SRE lead) - 2-3m
  - Uptime: 99.95% last 30 days (call out incident on 2/11 and remediation work)
  - Incident playbook improvements and on-call rotation changes
- People & culture (Zoe) - 1-2m
  - DEI initiative update, upcoming team retreat in May, onboarding improvements
- Close + transition to Q&A (Zoe) - 30s

Talking points - CEO (short script snippets)
- "This has been a strong quarter. Usage growth shows product-market fit at multiple customer segments - hosted API for rapid dev, Dedicated for scale, Private for regulated customers."
- "We closed two meaningful Dedicated deals that validate our thesis: customers want predictable cost and isolation. We're investing to make Dedicated onboarding faster and cheaper."
- "We know reliability matters. The 2/11 incident was unacceptable; we've implemented three mitigations and updated our operational runbooks. Thank you to SRE and on-call teams for the quick work."
- "Look ahead: GA for Private KMS integration in June, smaller latency wins via optimized kernel selection coming in Q3."

Talking points - Product/Eng
- "Optimize pilots show clear unit-cost wins - we'll publish a short case study and a best-practices playbook for customers and partners."
- "We're rolling out a per-route tracing hook in the Console beta; ask your PM for access if you want early feedback."

Q&A - anticipated questions and suggested answers (scratchpad)
1) Q: What happened on 2/11? Will it happen again?
   A: Brief timeline - root cause was autoscaler misconfiguration + a degraded kernel path that surfaced under a specific seq-length distribution. Fixed via: better autoscaler safeguards, kernel fallback, and additional load-testing for seq-length patterns. Ongoing: incident review doc (link) and chaos test scheduled.
   Notes: keep answer high-level, call out concrete steps and ETA for full regression tests (end of March).

2) Q: Are we still on track for Private GA?
   A: Yes - KMS integration GA target: June. Remaining items: final security review, upgrade tests on on-prem package, and a short pilot with a regulated customer in May.

3) Q: How are we addressing token cost complaints from customers?
   A: A few levers: Optimize recommendations (batching + caching), model quantization profiles, and routing policies to cheaper model variants for non-sensitive routes. Also we're preparing a cost-savings guide for customers.

4) Q: Hiring - are we freezing? Which roles are prioritized?
   A: We're not hiring broadly; we prioritize infra/SRE, Serving Runtime, and Sales for Dedicated. Hiring plan doc linked: jira:HR-2026-Q2-HC

5) Q: Roadmap transparency - can we get more detail?
   A: Commit to publishing a 30/60/90 internal roadmap for teams by mid-April. Will include measurable milestones and ownership.

Notes to self / things to check before finalizing
- Confirm exact MRR and growth numbers with Finance (Priya) - placeholder numbers in deck need update.
- Get a 1-slide screenshot from Optimize pilot (Lucas) - ask product for final metrics by 2026-03-05.
- Update incident remediation bullet points with links to postmortem (add to linked_artifacts).
- Tone: keep optimistic but honest. Avoid overly technical details in CEO remarks - save for product/SRE segments.
- Timing: total all-hands 45-50m max. Exec update 15-20, Q&A 20-30.

Open questions / Slack threads to follow up
- #sre-incident-2-11 (confirm final postmortem link)
- #product-optimize (permission to publish pilot numbers)
- #sales-enterprise (names of customers granted permission to be named)

Live Q&A facilitation notes (for Zoe / MC)
- Use the Slido-like tool for anonymous Qs and then prioritize high-vote questions; have 2-3 seeded questions ready.
- Panel: CEO, Head of Product, SRE lead, Head of Sales (optional).
- If a sensitive customer name question comes up, escalate to Head of Sales and avoid naming without consent.

Next steps / immediate TODOs (before final slide deck)
- [Zoe] collect final numbers from Priya (Finance) by 3/05
- [Lucas] finalize Optimize pilot slide by 3/05
- [Asha] draft Q&A moderator notes and seeding questions by 3/04
- [Priya] confirm Dedicated contract quotes and whether customers allow mention by name by 3/06

Rough draft for slide speaker notes (feel free to edit)
- CEO slide: (6m) intro, topline metrics, 2 customer vignettes, 1 ask (support sales by sharing product feedback)
- Product slide: (6m) highlight Optimize pilot + Private/GKM timeline + 2 bullets on upcoming features
- SRE slide: (2m) uptime + what we changed + how we'll prevent recurrence
- People slide: (1m) hires, retreat, DEI quick update

Misc (scratch)
- Possible live demo: show Console per-route tracing - risk: demo fragility. Plan B: screenshot/video.
- Consider short poll during all-hands: "Which feature should we prioritize for Q3?" (choices: streaming stability, lower latency for embeddings, batching UI in Console)

END DRAFT - please comment in doc.

(Voice notes: keep some items intentionally rough so execs can edit. This is the working doc; remove internal notes before final publish.)
